authorization: SELF-TEST - no real machine was audited

findings.title: Endpoint protection (antivirus)
findings.explanation: Microsoft Defender is running with real-time protection on and recent virus definitions.

findings.title: Host firewall
findings.explanation: The Windows firewall is off for the Public profile, so the machine accepts unsolicited inbound connections on untrusted networks.
findings.recommendation: Enable the firewall on all profiles (Set-NetFirewallProfile -All -Enabled True).

findings.title: Disk encryption at rest
findings.status: System drive NOT encrypted (FullyDecrypted / protection Off)
findings.explanation: The system drive is not encrypted. If the device is lost or stolen its data can be read directly.
findings.recommendation: Enable BitLocker on the system drive and escrow the recovery key.

findings.title: Patch cadence (Windows Update)
findings.explanation: The machine has not installed an update in over 45 days. Patch cadence should be monthly.
findings.recommendation: Run Windows Update and enable automatic updates.

findings.title: Built-in Administrator account
findings.explanation: The predictable built-in Administrator account is active, a common brute-force target.
findings.recommendation: Disable the built-in Administrator and use named admin accounts.

findings.title: Local administrator accounts
findings.explanation: The local Administrators group is a reasonable size.

findings.title: Remote Desktop (RDP) exposure
findings.status: RDP is ENABLED with Network Level Authentication OFF
findings.explanation: Remote Desktop accepts inbound connections without Network Level Authentication. RDP is a leading ransomware entry point.
findings.recommendation: Disable RDP if unused; otherwise require NLA, restrict to a VPN/jump host, and add MFA.

findings.title: SMBv1 file-sharing protocol
findings.explanation: The obsolete SMBv1 protocol is turned off.

findings.title: Automatic screen lock
findings.explanation: The machine locks when idle but the timeout is longer than the recommended 15 minutes.
findings.recommendation: Reduce the inactivity lock to 15 minutes or less.

findings.title: Password policy
findings.explanation: The local password policy meets the recommended baseline.

findings.title: Guest account
findings.explanation: The Guest account is disabled, as recommended.

findings.title: AutoRun / AutoPlay for removable media
findings.explanation: AutoRun/AutoPlay is not disabled for all drive types; a malicious USB device can auto-execute.

findings.title: Domain / workgroup membership
findings.explanation: The machine is not domain-joined, so security settings are managed one-by-one and can drift.
findings.recommendation: Consider central management so policy is applied consistently.
